log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought:
Lead: 39% BRING: torterra, 16% BRING: scrafty, 15% BRING: torkoal
Pick 2: 38% BRING: torkoal, 23% BRING: scrafty, 17% BRING: rotom
Pick 3: 44% BRING: rotom, 26% BRING: scrafty, 21% BRING: sinistchamasterpiece

Preview: I bring Incineroar (lead, Intimidate and Fake Out), Garchomp (Mega threat), and Gholdengo (special sweeper, good vs Torkoal, Simisear and Torterra). Opponent's team is heavy on Fire, Grass and Ground, so Garchomp and Gholdengo should hit hard. Expect Fire and Grass attacks; watch Rotom's Electric and Ghost typing. Lead Incineroar.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
I'm weighing team selections against this Fire/Grass/Ground-heavy opponent lineup, leaning toward Incineroar for intimidate and utility alongside strong picks like Garchomp and Kingambit.

My settled choice: bring Incineroar, Garchomp, and Gholdengo, since Gholdengo's coverage handles the fire/grass threats well without needing Sinistcha.

decisions.thought: 74% MOVE: trailblaze, 10% MOVE: bulldoze, 7% MOVE: energyball

Turn 1: Incineroar lead, Intimidate dropped Torterra's Attack. Opponent known so far: Torterra (Overgrow or Shell Armor), plus Rotom, Torkoal, Scrafty, Sinistcha, Simisear. Plan: Fake Out now for tempo, then Flare Blitz Torterra (super effective). Garchomp (Mega) and Gholdengo come in later; watch for Fire and Grass attacks and Rotom's Electric and Ghost typing.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Since Incineroar is going first this turn, Fake Out is available and will flinch Torterra while chipping some damage, plus Intimidate already dropped its Attack. I'll save Flare Blitz for next turn since it's super effective anyway, so Fake Out is the right call now.

decisions.thought: 46% MOVE: trailblaze, 19% MOVE: bulldoze, 13% MOVE: growth

Plan: Incineroar (Intimidate, Fake Out) leads. Torterra is at 87% with Attack lowered by Intimidate. Flare Blitz is super effective, so I'm hitting it now. Garchomp (Mega) and Gholdengo come in later. Gholdengo is good vs Torkoal, Simisear and Torterra. Watch Rotom's Electric/Ghost typing. Opponent so far: Torterra (Overgrow or Shell Armor), with Rotom, Torkoal, Scrafty, Sinistcha and Simisear unseen. Incineroar has Sitrus Berry.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: With Torterra at 87% against my Incineroar, Flare Blitz is super effective and should deal heavy damage despite the recoil. Torterra is likely slower, so I'll commit to Flare Blitz rather than Protect.

decisions.thought: 37% MOVE: risingvoltage, 25% MOVE: discharge, 15% MOVE: charge

Opponent: Torterra is down. Rotom (Electric/Ghost, Levitate) is in and may outspeed Incineroar. Gholdengo resists Electric, and Shadow Ball is super effective on Rotom. Plan: bring in Gholdengo, then use Shadow Ball. Keep Garchomp (Mega) for later. Still unseen: Torkoal, Scrafty, Sinistcha or Simisear. Watch for Will-O-Wisp and Fire moves.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Flare Blitz against Rotom is neutral damage since Fire doesn't hit Electric/Ghost super effectively, and Rotom outspeeds Incineroar anyway, so I'm weighing whether to stay in with Thunderbolt or Shadow Ball, or switch to something like Gholdengo to handle the matchup better.

Actually Gholdengo switching in could be strong: it's faster and its Shadow Ball hits Rotom's Ghost typing super effectively, while Make It Rain stays neutral. The cost of switching Incineroar out seems minimal compared to the damage Gholdengo could deal.

Electric is neutral against Incineroar anyway, so that's not a big factor. I'll go with Gholdengo here.

decisions.thought: 46% MOVE: risingvoltage, 20% MOVE: discharge, 14% MOVE: charge

Gholdengo (112/164, Life Orb) is in against Rotom (Electric/Ghost, Levitate). Rotom has shown only Rising Voltage. Electric is resisted by Steel and Good as Gold blocks status, so Gholdengo is safe. Shadow Ball is super effective on Rotom and should do heavy damage. Remaining opponents to watch for: Torkoal, Scrafty, Sinistcha or Simisear, with Fire and Grass attacks. Garchomp (Mega) and Incineroar (Sitrus) are held back for later.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Gholdengo at 112/164 is facing Rotom, and Shadow Ball should hit super effectively while Rotom's Rising Voltage won't do much against my Steel typing, plus Good as Gold keeps me immune to status. I'm also checking speed tiers since Gholdengo could plausibly outpace Rotom.

With 203 SpA and Life Orb boosting Shadow Ball's STAB and super-effective damage, this looks like it could seriously dent or even knock out Rotom, so I'll go with Shadow Ball.

decisions.note: Only one legal action: played without asking.

decisions.thought: 44% MOVE: flamethrower, 20% MOVE: flamecharge, 19% MOVE: firespin

Opponent has lost Torterra and Rotom. Torkoal is now active at full HP, is very slow (36-79 Spe), and may set Sun via Drought. Gholdengo (96/164, Life Orb) outspeeds it and is immune to status via Good as Gold. Make It Rain is not very effective on Torkoal, so I'm using Shadow Ball. Remaining threats: Scrafty, Sinistcha, Simisear. Garchomp (Mega-capable) and Incineroar (Sitrus) are held back. Watch for Fire attacks hitting Gholdengo.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Torkoal is full HP and Fire-type, so Shadow Ball hits neutrally while Make It Rain gets resisted by Fire since Steel isn't effective against it.

decisions.thought: Gholdengo fell to Torkoal's Flamethrower after Shadow Ball. Torkoal is at 16% HP, is very slow, and is weak to Ground. Garchomp (full HP) comes in to take a hit and then Earthquake Torkoal. Keep Garchomp's Mega in reserve. Incineroar (71%, Sitrus) is the backup. Still unseen: Scrafty, Sinistcha, and Simisear, which may be Fire or Grass threats. Opponent moves so far: Flamethrower (Torkoal), Rising Voltage (Rotom).
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
With Gholdengo down, I need to pick between full-HP Garchomp or Incineroar at 71%. Torkoal is at 16% and slow, so Garchomp easily outpaces it and should finish it off with any hit.

Earthquake is super effective against pure Fire-type Torkoal, so Garchomp can take it out without even needing to Mega Evolve, saving that resource for later. I'll switch in Garchomp and plan to use Earthquake next turn.

decisions.thought: 31% MOVE: firespin, 25% MOVE: flamethrower, 24% MOVE: flamecharge

Garchomp outranges Torkoal (169 vs 36-79 Speed) and Earthquake is super effective, so it should KO the 16% Torkoal without Mega. Keep Mega in reserve. Known opposing moves: Flamethrower (Torkoal), Rising Voltage (Rotom, now fainted). Unseen: Scrafty, Sinistcha, Simisear, which may bring Fire or Grass attacks. Incineroar (71%, Sitrus) is the backup; Gholdengo is down.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Torkoal's at 16% HP and slow, so Garchomp outspeeds and Earthquake is super effective against pure Fire-type Torkoal, likely securing the kill without needing to mega evolve.
